verdict.rationale: Brave Search API does ship AI-generated output. It offers an Answers endpoint with grounded, source-backed answers that can be streamed and called through the OpenAI SDK, an AI summarizer over search results, LLM-generated POI descriptions, and query suggestions. However, all of these work on Brave's web index rather than on the user's own data, and they are delivered as API responses rather than as insights surfaced inside a product UI. missing for 10: AI insights generated from the user's own data, an in-product insight/suggestion experience, and independent or hands-on corroboration of answer and summary quality.
